verdict: Leads jumped 56% this week; overdue milestones are limiting what comes next.
narrative: In the last 28 days you received 37 leads at an average cost of $42.27 per lead, and this past week saw both lead volume rise 56% and cost per lead fall 15% compared to the prior seven days — a genuine efficiency gain driven by Meta. Google Ads is running spend but is not yet registering attributed conversions, and confirming the status of the heating campaigns and Local Services Ads is the immediate next step. Your Google Business Profile recorded zero actions on each of the last three days of the period after averaging five to six per day earlier in October, which points to a local visibility dip we are actively watching. A set of planned milestones — including intake automation, LSA re-enablement, and the heating campaign launch — are past their scheduled dates, and clearing those unlocks the budget scale-up planned for October 31. Resolving those items is the priority this coming week so the strong paid-media efficiency you are already seeing can be matched with higher volume.
